verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents Triggers and SLO-based alerts that fire on threshold/burn-rate conditions and route notifications to Slack, PagerDuty, Microsoft Teams, or custom webhooks, covering alerting on telemetry signals and routing. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of alert grouping (deduplication/aggregation) or silencing/muting of notifications. missing for 10: explicit docs on notification grouping/deduplication, silencing or snoozing alerts.
